title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mohegan Sun Arena, Uncasville | 2008
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut, USA, on 22 June 2008.

It was the third show by the tenth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 29 dates between June and August 2008.

Starr had previously performed at the Mohegan Sun Arena on 31 July 2003 and 16 July 2006. He returned there on 27 June 2010, 17 June 2012, and 20 September 2024.

The tenth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
